items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: He called me as late as 8.30 in the evening, maybe 9 o'clock, asked me if I could get the boys together and come up.

ctx.x: Well, it was quite a nice home. We played up there many times with my orchestra after theater parties and things like that. He called me as late as 8.30 in the evening, maybe 9 o'clock, asked me if I could get the boys together and come up. We'd do it. We'd get together and go on up and play a job for them. Have a lot of fun at the same time. Did I mention anything about the Owls being on our taping here? Very little.
Very little. Just sort of in-
